title: 6 Bedrooms, Hot Tub, Rooftop, Garage + by Downtown
description:
Luxury 6-bedroom home with stunning skyline views & a garage near Germantown & Downtown Broadway. Expansive doors open from the kitchen to a balcony, creating seamless indoor-outdoor living. Enjoy a private rooftop with hot tub, lounge seating & a fire pit, plus a game room with foosball, TV and wet bar. Walk to restaurants, coffee, shopping, bars, the Farmers Market and Bicentennial Park. High-end furnishings, a gas fire place and a luxe primary bath with heated floors. Each bedroom has a TV.

The space

★ 7 Beds - 2 King Bed, Queen over Queen Bunk Bed + 3 Queen Beds

NO parties or locals guests allowed to book this property. Only the number of guests listed with the reservation allowed at the property at all times. This is monitored with outside cameras. Do not book if you can't follow these rules.

After a fun day out exploring Nashville, come back to relax in this inviting, centrally-located luxury home. All aspects of our home were thoughtfully designed with high-end furnishings. Spend your downtime in the cozy living room, playing foosball with friends, or relax in the hot tub on our rooftop patio. The airport is only about 15 minutes away, and there are plenty of affordable Ubers, Lyft and taxis available. Our home is in a great location to enjoy all the things that Nashville has to offer.

At SkyShare Management, hospitality is what we do best. With 15+ years of property management experience, we combine professionalism with a personal touch to make every stay effortless and enjoyable. Our team provides fast, friendly guest support through Airbnb messaging, seamless check-in details, and local recommendations to help you discover the best spots and hidden gems the city has to offer.
